CustomField.description: This is a URL created via a formula. Use this link to verify that the ID entered in the Case Feed Email Template ID field accurately identifies your desired Template.
CustomField.formula: IF( LEN(Case_Feed_Email_Template_Id__c)<>15 || LEFT(Case_Feed_Email_Template_Id__c,3)<>"00X" , "Enter a valid ID in the Case Feed Email Template ID field" , HYPERLINK("/"&Case_Feed_Email_Template_Id__c,"Click to View Associated Template") )
